Digital marketing

SEO strategy in Pakistan.

Help buyers find the right pages when they search for your products and services in Pakistan.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Start with search intent

We compare the terms buyers use with the pages already on your site. You see which pages need editing, which need building and where several pages compete for the same search.

Make the right pages visible

Technical fixes, on-page editing, content planning, relevant links and location pages form one programme. Work is sequenced around your market and resources.

Review the results

We report search visibility, traffic and enquiries together. Your monthly review covers completed work and the priorities for the next cycle.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • Essentials — keyword planning, on-page work for up to ten priority pages and technical checks.
  • Growth — four new pages or guides per month, coverage for up to three cities and digital PR.
  • Custom — a scoped plan for e-commerce, larger sites or multiple brands, with a named contact.
Questions

Before you start.

How is my monthly fee set?

A review of your site, competitors and goals informs a fixed written quote. The appropriate plan depends on the work your market needs.

Which language should our pages use?

We look at how your customers search, then plan English, Urdu or Roman Urdu content to suit those searches.

What access helps you get started?

Website access and existing Search Console and Analytics accounts are useful. We can help set up measurement when those accounts are missing.
